steps: POST /api/auth/register with email, password, and name
Verify response contains user object and JWT token
Save token for subsequent requests
Verify user can access protected routes with token
Register a new user first (if not exists)
POST /api/auth/login with email and password
Verify response contains user object and JWT token
Use token to access protected endpoints
Obtain valid JWT token from login/register
GET /api/auth/verify with Authorization header
Verify response confirms token validity
Verify user data is returned correctly
Login and obtain JWT token
PUT /api/auth/profile with new name
Verify response contains updated user data
GET /api/auth/me to confirm update persisted
Login and obtain JWT token
GET /api/protected with Authorization header
Verify access granted and data returned
Test without token to verify 401 response

notes: No seed data found in db.sql - users must be created via API
Database uses bcrypt password hashing with 12 salt rounds
All endpoints use JSON request/response format
Passwords must be at least 6 characters long
Email addresses are stored in lowercase and trimmed
No role-based access control detected in current implementation
